title: nan
authors: Wyder P.M.; Chen Y.-S.; Lasrado A.J.; Pelles R.J.; Kwiatkowski R.; Comas E.O.A.; Kennedy R.; Mangla A.; Huang Z.; Hu X.; Xiong Z.; Aharoni T.; Chuang T.-C.; Lipson H.
key_contribution: Presents an all-onboard autonomous drone hunting system using Tiny YOLO and visual servoing for target tracking and follow in GPS-denied environments, validated on a physical platform.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
